# The second equation, from the area

<!-- STEP id="area" -->
The displacement s is the area under the velocity-time line from 0 to t. It splits into a rectangle, u x t, and a triangle, 1/2 x t x (v - u).

<!-- STEP id="result" -->
From the first equation, v - u = at. So s = ut + 1/2 x t x at, that is, **s = ut + 1/2 at²**.

<!-- STEP id="trapezium" -->
Try at home: the whole area is a trapezium. Use the area formula for a trapezium to get another equation, s = 1/2 (u + v) t.
